001: Haoran, the exam is next week. How's your review going?
Don't even mention it. I feel like I'm not ready at all, and I'm really nervous.
Don't worry, let's study together. Two heads are better than one.
Really? That's great. I actually have some questions I wanted to ask you.
No problem. Let's go to the library this afternoon and go over the key points together.
Okay, then I'll see you at the library at two. I'll organize my notes first.
002: Jingyi, did you go to the review lecture yesterday? How was it?
Yes, I did. The teacher explained everything really clearly and highlighted a lot of key points.
That's great. Could you lend me your notes?
Of course, but my handwriting is a bit messy. I hope you can read it.
That's fine, as long as I can get the general idea. Thanks a lot.
You're welcome. If there's anything you don't understand, feel free to ask me anytime.
003: Tianyou, how far have you gotten in your review? I keep forgetting this part.
I just finished chapter three. I feel like those definitions are really easy to mix up.
Me too! How about we quiz each other? That way we'll remember it better.
That's a good idea. You ask me first, and I'll try to answer.
Okay, here I go. Are you ready?
Ready. Go ahead and ask away. If I can't answer, I'll treat you to a meal.
004: Jiaqi, how do you plan to review English? I forget the vocabulary as soon as I memorize it.
I go over it once in the morning and once at night, then do a few reading passages to reinforce it.
No wonder your English is so good. So you have a method after all.
You can try it too. Stick with it for a few days and you'll see results.
Okay, I'll start trying from today. I hope it's not too late.
It's not too late. You still have a week. Don't put too much pressure on yourself.
005: Zixuan, have you printed out the review materials? I wanted to borrow them to make a copy.
I printed them out yesterday. If you want, I'll just give you a copy.
That's great. How much was it? I'll transfer you the money.
Don't worry about it. It only cost a few bucks. Just take it.
I feel bad about that. Next time I'll treat you to bubble tea.
Sounds good. It's a deal then. Good luck on the exam!
006: Yuxuan, what types of questions do you think will be on this exam?
The teacher said there will be multiple choice and short answer questions, and there might be an essay question too.
I'm a bit worried about the essay question. I don't know how to organize my answer.
You can start by making an outline. Write down the main points, then expand on them.
That makes sense. I'll do that when I practice.
Right. After practicing a few times, you'll get the hang of it, and you won't panic during the exam.
007: Haoran, what time did you study until last night? You look really tired.
I studied until one in the morning, but I still feel like there's so much I haven't covered.
Staying up late to study isn't effective. You should get to bed earlier.
You're right, but there's not enough time, and I'm really anxious.
Don't worry. Focus on mastering the key points first. As for the rest, just cover as much as you can.
Yeah, you're right. I'll go to bed early tonight and get up early tomorrow to review.
008: Jingyi, did you do the practice test? I thought the last big question was really hard.
Yeah, I did it. That question was indeed a bit complicated. I couldn't solve it at first either.
So how did you figure it out? Can you walk me through your approach?
I looked at the answer later and realized you have to draw a diagram first. Once you label the conditions, it becomes clear.
I see. Let me try it again then. Thanks for telling me.
You're welcome. If there's anything else you don't get, we can discuss it together tonight.
009: Tianyou, how are you planning to get to school on exam day? Let's take a taxi together.
I'm planning to take the subway. I'm worried about traffic in the morning, and the subway is more punctual.
Good point. Then let's meet at the subway station at a set time.
Okay, let's meet at the entrance of line two at seven thirty. Don't be late.
Don't worry. I've set my alarm, so I'll definitely be there on time.
Good. Let's remind each other so we don't forget the exam time.
010: Jiaqi, do you have any plans after the exam? Want to go out and relax a bit?
Sure. I heard there's a new hotpot place that opened up, and the reviews are really good.
Then it's settled. After the exam, we'll go have a big feast.
But before that, we need to focus on reviewing and not think too far ahead.
Haha, you're right. Let's do well on the exam first, then worry about everything else.
Yeah, let's work hard together and aim for great grades!
